title: σωτηρία ἀπὸ Λύκου
learning_goal: Practice present-tense narration alongside first/second-person statements and commands with vocative ὦ and explicit subjects/objects.
plot: Hyperbrephos hears Glaux and Panda in danger from Lukos, rushes outside, throws a stone to drive him away, and the friends resume playing with the ball.

frames.text: ἡ Γλαῦξ καὶ ἡ Πάνδα παίζουσιν μετὰ τῆς σφαίρας παρὰ τῷ δένδρῳ.
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Glaux perches under the shade tree on the right, three-quarter left view, eyes on the ball between her and Panda.
Panda stands under the tree on the left, three-quarter right view, looking toward Glaux and the ball.
The red leather ball rests on the ground centered between Glaux and Panda under the tree.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone lies on the cobblestone path at the foreground right near the tree roots.
motivations: Glaux is happily playing catch with Panda by the tree behind the cottage and is focused on the game.
Panda is cheerful and intent on throwing the ball to Glaux in their friendly play.
frames.artist_notes: FADE IN wide establishing; cottage small in far background, friendly shade tree foreground.
frames.camera: Wide establishing shot foregrounding the shade tree with the cottage far behind.

frames.text: λέγει ἡ Πάνδα· «ἐγώ νῦν βάλλω τὴν σφαῖραν, ὦ Γλαῦξ.»
frames.speaker: Panda
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Panda remains on the left, three-quarter right view, arm drawn back, holding the ball at chest height while looking at Glaux.
Glaux stands on the right ready to catch, three-quarter left view, eyes fixed on Panda’s paw.
The red leather ball is gripped in Panda’s right paw, raised and ready to throw.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone remains on the path at the foreground right near the tree roots.
motivations: Panda announces her throw to make the action clear to Glaux during the game.
Glaux anticipates the catch and watches Panda’s movement closely.
frames.camera: Medium two-shot of Panda and Glaux facing each other with the ball between them.

frames.text: ὁ Λύκος νῦν προσέρχεται πρὸς τὸ δένδρον.
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Panda stands left, three-quarter right view, following the ball with her eyes.
Glaux stands right, wing lifted to catch, three-quarter left view, eyes on the ball.
The red leather ball arcs gently through the air between Panda and Glaux.
Lukos steps into frame from the far right background along the path, three-quarter left view, eyes on the players.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone remains on the path at the foreground right near the tree roots.
motivations: Panda is still engaged in the throw and watches the ball’s path.
Glaux prepares to receive the throw and stays focused on the incoming ball.
Lukos approaches the tree because he is hungry and has noticed the two small friends playing.
frames.artist_notes: Start close on the ball’s arc, then pan to reveal Lukos entering.
frames.camera: Close on the ball as it arcs; pan right revealing Lukos; widen to include the players.

frames.text: λέγει ὁ Λύκος· «ἐγώ νῦν βούλομαι ὑμᾶς ἐσθίειν.»
frames.speaker: Lukos
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Lukos is midground right, closer than before, three-quarter left view, looming slightly toward the others.
Panda on the left recoils a little, three-quarter right view, glancing nervously toward Lukos.
Glaux on the right fluffs slightly, three-quarter left view, looking firmly at Lukos.
The red leather ball is now in Glaux’s talons near her chest from the completed catch.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone still lies on the path at the foreground right.
motivations: Glaux feels protective because Lukos threatens her and Panda.
Panda is startled by Lukos’s threat and tenses up.
Lukos states his intention because he is hungry and sees easy prey.
frames.camera: Three-shot with Lukos now clearly in the scene, medium framing to show reactions.

frames.text: λέγει ἡ Γλαῦξ· «ὦ Ὑπερβρέφος, βοήθει ἡμῖν νῦν.»
frames.speaker: Glaux
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Glaux is on the right in a tight view, head turned toward the distant house off-screen left, beak open to call.
Panda is on the left, close beside Glaux, looking the same direction with worried eyes.
The red leather ball is tucked under Glaux’s right wing.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone remains on the path at the foreground right, slightly out of focus.
motivations: Glaux calls for Hyperbrephos because Lukos has threatened them, and she trusts his help.
Panda anxiously joins the call because she fears Lukos and wants protection.
frames.camera: Tight two-shot on Glaux and Panda for an emotional reaction moment.

frames.text: ὁ Ὑπερβρέφος ἀκούει τὴν φωνὴν καὶ τρέχει ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας.
objects: an open honey-colored wooden door with a rounded top leading outside
positioning: Ὑπερβρέφος stands near the left by the bed, three-quarter right view, turning and starting to run toward the bright doorway.
The open honey-colored wooden door with a rounded top stands at the center-right, light spilling through to the exit.
motivations: Ὑπερβρέφος hears the urgent call from Glaux and Panda and immediately rushes to help his friends.
frames.camera: Medium on the cozy doorway area; a shaft of light points clearly to the exit.

frames.text: ὁ Ὑπερβρέφος τρέχει διὰ τῆς θύρας καὶ ἔξω πρὸς τὸ δένδρον.
objects: an open honey-colored wooden door with a rounded top leading outside
a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Ὑπερβρέφος is mid-run passing through the doorway toward the bright outside, back three-quarter view, eyes forward.
The open honey-colored wooden door swings slightly on its hinges behind him as he passes.
The red leather ball sits under the tree outside in the mid-left background, visible through the doorway.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone lies on the exterior path at the foreground right near the tree, visible ahead.
motivations: Ὑπερβρέφος is determined to reach his endangered friends quickly after hearing their plea.
frames.artist_notes: FOLLOW SHOT continuing from interior toward the exterior tree.
frames.camera: Follow from behind as he dashes through the door, carrying momentum into the exterior path.

frames.text: ὁ Ὑπερβρέφος λαμβάνει τὸν λίθον καὶ βάλλει τὸν λίθον πρὸς τὸν Λύκον.
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Ὑπερβρέφος is foreground left, three-quarter right view, releasing the stone toward Lukos with a strong throw, eyes fixed on him.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone has just left Ὑπερβρέφος’ hand and is mid-flight toward Lukos on the right.
Lukos is mid-right, flinching and leaning back, three-quarter left view, eyes on the oncoming stone.
Glaux and Panda are under the tree mid-left behind Ὑπερβρέφος, watching him intently.
The red leather ball lies near Glaux’s feet under the tree.
motivations: Ὑπερβρέφος throws the stone to protect his friends from the threatening Lukos.
Lukos is startled by the sudden counter and worries about being struck.
Glaux is relieved to see help arrive and watches the throw.
Panda feels hopeful as Ὑπερβρέφος defends them.
frames.camera: Tracking arrives with Ὑπερβρέφος; reframe to a wide that includes all four characters and the flight of the stone.

frames.text: λέγει ὁ Ὑπερβρέφος· «ὦ Λύκε, μὴ προσέρχου πρὸς τοὺς φίλους ἐμοὺς.»
frames.speaker: Ὑπερβρέφος
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Ὑπερβρέφος stands firm foreground left, three-quarter right view, arm extended from the throw, eyes stern on Lukos.
Lukos is mid-right, recoiling with ears back, three-quarter left view, watching the stone approach.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone is midair near Lukos’s chest.
Glaux and Panda remain under the tree at mid-left, looking toward Lukos and Ὑπερβρέφος.
The red leather ball rests on the ground near Glaux’s feet.
motivations: Ὑπερβρέφος warns Lukos because he wants to protect his friends and stop the approach.
Lukos hesitates because he fears being hit by the stone.
Glaux watches closely, ready to react if needed after calling for help.
Panda stays near Glaux, trusting Ὑπερβρέφος to defend them.
frames.camera: Medium-close across the conflict line to highlight Ὑπερβρέφος and Lukos.

frames.text: λέγει ὁ Λύκος· «οἴμοι· μὴ βάλλε τὸν λίθον εἰς ἐμέ· ἐγώ ἀπέρχομαι νῦν.»
frames.speaker: Lukos
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Lukos steps back to the right with hands raised, three-quarter left view, eyes on the stone.
Ὑπερβρέφος stands his ground at foreground left, three-quarter right view, watching Lukos.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone whizzes past Lukos’s chest toward the ground on the right.
Glaux and Panda stay under the tree mid-left, watching with relief starting to show.
The red leather ball remains near Glaux’s feet.
motivations: Lukos yields because he fears being struck and decides to depart.
Ὑπερβρέφος maintains a firm stance to ensure Lukos retreats.
Glaux begins to feel safe again as Lukos backs away.
Panda relaxes slightly, seeing Lukos change his mind.
frames.camera: Medium on Lukos’s reaction, with the others framed to the left for context.

frames.text: ὁ Λύκος φεύγει ἀπὸ τοῦ δένδρου.
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Lukos retreats toward the right edge of the frame along the path, back three-quarter view, looking back nervously.
Ὑπερβρέφος stands near the tree at left-center, three-quarter right view, watching Lukos depart.
Glaux and Panda stand together under the tree at left, looking after the fleeing Lukos.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone now lies on the path near where Lukos stood on the right.
The red leather ball rests near Glaux’s feet under the tree.
motivations: Lukos flees the scene because he does not want to be hit and has given up his threat.
Ὑπερβρέφος confirms that his friends are safe as the danger leaves.
Glaux feels relief seeing Lukos go away from the tree.
Panda calms down now that the threat is leaving.
frames.camera: Wider shot as Lukos backs away and exits the frame.

frames.text: λέγει ἡ Πάνδα· «εὐχαριστῶ σοι, ὦ Ὑπερβρέφος.»
frames.speaker: Panda
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Panda and Ὑπερβρέφος are centered in a medium two-shot, facing each other, Panda smiling gratefully.
Glaux enters from the left edge carrying the red leather ball tucked under her wing, looking at them.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone lies on the path at the right background near the tree.
motivations: Panda thanks Ὑπερβρέφος because he protected her and Glaux from Lukos.
Ὑπερβρέφος smiles because his friends are safe after his help.
Glaux approaches with the ball, ready to resume the peaceful game now that the danger has passed.
frames.camera: Medium two-shot on Panda and Ὑπερβρέφος with Glaux entering at the edge.

frames.text: ἡ Γλαῦξ καὶ ἡ Πάνδα πάλιν παίζουσιν μετὰ τῆς σφαίρας.
objects: a small round red leather ball with white stitches, slightly scuffed from play
a smooth palm-sized gray stone lying near the cobblestone path
positioning: Glaux stands on the right under the tree, three-quarter left view, ready to catch again, eyes on the ball.
Panda stands on the left tossing the ball toward Glaux, three-quarter right view, smiling.
Ὑπερβρέφος stands slightly behind them left-center, three-quarter right view, smiling proudly at his friends.
The red leather ball arcs midair between Panda and Glaux once more.
The smooth palm-sized gray stone rests on the path at the right, undisturbed.
motivations: Glaux returns to the game now that the danger has ended.
Panda happily resumes play with Glaux after thanking Ὑπερβρέφος.
Ὑπερβρέφος watches contentedly because his friends are safe and joyful.
frames.camera: Comfortable wide shot; peaceful mood as play resumes under the shade tree.
